verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS incident-management product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows incident.io publishing its source under an open license. The Terraform provider, the OpenAPI spec and the MCP server are integration surfaces, not open-source product code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
